sources.label: Verified exact-deployment VaultV2 source and gate abdication semantics
Sourcify verified exact-deployment VaultV2 source and ABI

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-08. At Ethereum block 26148411, asset() returned canonical USDC (0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48); receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate, and receiveAssetsGate were zero, and all three setters were permanently abdicated. The verified immutable VaultV2 source enforces abdication and has no administrator-only seizure, forced holder burn, or upgrade path. Those facts exclude a direct holder-freeze verdict but do not remove the vault's USDC exposure: Circle can blacklist USDC accounts and block underlying transfers, including settlement to a blacklisted recipient. Under the tracked parent/wrapper rule, steakUSDC therefore inherits USDC's freeze exposure and is Upstream. This corrects the 2026-10-01 No verdict, which scoped its conclusion to direct share controls and omitted the required parent inheritance.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: steakUSDC is tracked only as an Ethereum Morpho vault token in Pharos. The reviewed Steakhouse and Morpho sources do not show a durable bridge route for the vault share.
